verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנְנִי֙ מֵעִ֣יר עַל־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לֵ֣ב קָמָ֑י ר֖וּחַ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî mê·‘îr ‘al- bā·ḇel wə·’el- yō·šə·ḇê lêḇ qā·māy rū·aḥ maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Behold I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai . . . the spirit of a destroyer

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י זָרִים֙ לְבָבֶ֤ל׀ וְזֵר֔וּהָ וִיבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî zā·rîm lə·ḇā·ḇel wə·zê·rū·hā wî·ḇō·qə·qū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣāh kî- hā·yū ‘ā·le·hā mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·yō·wm rā·‘āh
verses.literal: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster

verses.original: אֶֽל־ יִדְרֹ֤ךְ הַדֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ יִתְעַ֖ל בְּסִרְיֹנ֑וֹ וְאַֽל־ וְאֶל־ תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל־ בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔יהָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כָּל־ צְבָאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- yiḏ·rōḵ had·dō·rêḵ qaš·tōw yiṯ·‘al bə·sir·yō·nōw wə·’al- wə·’el- taḥ·mə·lū ’el- ba·ḥu·re·hā ha·ḥă·rî·mū kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’āh
verses.literal: - Do not let the archer bend his bow [or] put on his armor . . . Do not spare . . . her young men devote all her army {to destruction}

verses.original: וְנָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וּמְדֻקָּרִ֖ים בְּחוּצוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ḥă·lā·lîm bə·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm ū·mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm bə·ḥū·ṣō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans and pierced through in her streets

verses.original: כִּ֠י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ לֹֽא־ אַלְמָ֨ן מֵֽאֱלֹהָ֔יו מֵֽיְהוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֤י אַרְצָם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִקְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh lō- ’al·mān mê·’ĕ·lō·hāw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî ’ar·ṣām mā·lə·’āh ’ā·šām miq·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God the LORD of Hosts though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: נֻ֣סוּ׀ מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּמַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אַל־ תִּדַּ֖מּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּי֩ הִיא֙ עֵ֨ת לַֽיהוָ֔ה נְקָמָ֥ה ה֥וּא מְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃ גְּמ֕וּל
verses.transliteration: nu·sū mit·tō·wḵ bā·ḇel ū·mal·lə·ṭū ’îš nap̄·šōw ’al- tid·dam·mū ba·‘ă·wō·nāh kî hî ‘êṯ Yah·weh nə·qā·māh hū mə·šal·lêm lāh gə·mūl
verses.literal: Flee from Babylon Escape with your lives Do not be destroyed in her punishment For this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance He will pay her what she deserves

verses.original: בָּבֶל֙ זָהָ֤ב כּוֹס־ בְּיַד־ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת גוֹיִ֔ם שָׁת֣וּ מִיֵּינָהּ֙ עַל־ כֵּ֖ן גוֹיִֽם׃ יִתְהֹלְל֥וּ
verses.transliteration: bā·ḇel zā·hāḇ kō·ws- bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ mə·šak·ke·reṯ ḡō·w·yim šā·ṯū mî·yê·nāh ‘al- kên ḡō·w·yim yiṯ·hō·lə·lū
verses.literal: Babylon was a gold cup in the hand of the LORD making the whole earth drunk The nations drank her wine therefore . . . the nations have gone mad

verses.original: פִּתְאֹ֛ם בָבֶ֖ל נָפְלָ֥ה וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ עָלֶ֗יהָ קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְמַכְאוֹבָ֔הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: piṯ·’ōm ḇā·ḇel nā·p̄ə·lāh wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr hê·lî·lū ‘ā·le·hā qə·ḥū ṣo·rî lə·maḵ·’ō·w·ḇāh ’ū·lay tê·rā·p̄ê
verses.literal: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered Wail for her get her balm for her pain perhaps she can be healed

verses.original: רִפִּאנוּ אֶת־ בָּבֶל֙ וְלֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה עִזְב֕וּהָ אִ֣ישׁ וְנֵלֵ֖ךְ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔הּ נָגַ֤ע אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְנִשָּׂ֖א עַד־ שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rip·pi·nū ’eṯ- bā·ḇel wə·lō nir·pā·ṯāh ‘iz·ḇū·hā ’îš wə·nê·lêḵ lə·’ar·ṣōw kî- miš·pā·ṭāh nā·ḡa‘ ’el- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·niś·śā ‘aḏ- šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: We tried to heal - Babylon but she could not be healed Abandon her Let each of us go to his own land for her judgment extends to the sky and reaches to the clouds

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה הוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ בֹּ֚אוּ וּנְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְצִיּ֔וֹן יְהוָ֥ה אֶֽת־ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯê·nū bō·’ū ū·nə·sap·pə·rāh ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ma·‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: The LORD has brought forth - our vindication come let us tell in Zion what the LORD - our God has accomplished

verses.original: הָבֵ֣רוּ הַחִצִּים֮ מִלְא֣וּ הַשְּׁלָטִים֒ יְהוָ֗ה הֵעִ֣יר אֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י כִּֽי־ מְזִמָּת֖וֹ עַל־ בָּבֶ֥ל לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇê·rū ha·ḥiṣ·ṣîm mil·’ū haš·šə·lā·ṭîm Yah·weh hê·‘îr ’eṯ- rū·aḥ mal·ḵê mā·ḏay kî- mə·zim·mā·ṯōw ‘al- bā·ḇel lə·haš·ḥî·ṯāh kî- hî niq·maṯ Yah·weh niq·maṯ hê·ḵā·lōw
verses.literal: Sharpen the arrows Fill the quivers The LORD has aroused - the spirit of the kings of the Medes because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her for it [is] the vengeance of the LORD vengeance for His temple

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ נֵ֗ס אֶל־ חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל הַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֙ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָאֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י יְהוָ֔ה גַּם־ זָמַ֣ם גַּם־ עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- nês ’el- ḥō·w·mōṯ bā·ḇel ha·ḥă·zî·qū ham·miš·mār hā·qî·mū šō·mə·rîm hā·ḵî·nū hā·’ō·rə·ḇîm kî Yah·weh gam- zā·mam gam- ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’el- yō·šə·ḇê ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: Raise a banner against the walls of Babylon post the guard station the watchmen prepare the ambush For the LORD has both devised and accomplished - what He spoke against the people of Babylon

verses.original: שֹׁכַנְתִּי עַל־ רַבִּ֔ים מַ֣יִם רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת קִצֵּ֖ךְ בָּ֥א אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·ḵan·tī ‘al- rab·bîm ma·yim rab·baṯ ’ō·w·ṣā·rōṯ qiṣ·ṣêḵ bā ’am·maṯ biṣ·‘êḵ
verses.literal: You who dwell by many waters rich in treasures your end has come the thread of your life is cut

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת נִשְׁבַּ֛ע בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־ מִלֵּאתִ֤יךְ אָדָם֙ כַּיֶּ֔לֶק וְעָנ֥וּ הֵידָֽד׃ס עָלַ֖יִךְ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ niš·ba‘ bə·nap̄·šōw kî ’im- mil·lê·ṯîḵ ’ā·ḏām kay·ye·leq wə·‘ā·nū hê·ḏāḏ ‘ā·la·yiḵ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts has sworn by Himself Surely . . . I will fill you up with men as with locusts and they will shout in triumph . . . over you

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ’e·reṣ bə·ḵō·ḥōw mê·ḵîn tê·ḇêl bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw nā·ṭāh šā·mā·yim ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: [The LORD] made the earth by His power He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding

verses.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם הֲמ֥וֹן נְשִׂאִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַל מִקְצֵה־ אָ֑רֶץ עָשָׂ֔ה בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ וַיֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·wl tit·tōw ma·yim baš·šā·ma·yim hă·mō·wn nə·śi·’îm way·ya·‘al miq·ṣêh- ’ā·reṣ ‘ā·śāh bə·rā·qîm lam·mā·ṭār way·yō·ṣê rū·aḥ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāw
verses.literal: When He thunders . . . the waters in the heavens roar He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses

verses.original: כָּל־ אָדָם֙ נִבְעַ֤ר מִדַּ֔עַת כָּל־ צֹרֵ֖ף הֹבִ֥ישׁ מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י נִסְכּ֖וֹ שֶׁ֥קֶר וְלֹא־ ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ā·ḏām niḇ·‘ar mid·da·‘aṯ kāl- ṣō·rêp̄ hō·ḇîš mip·pā·sel kî nis·kōw še·qer wə·lō- rū·aḥ bām
verses.literal: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols For his molten images are a fraud and [there is] no breath in them

verses.original: הֵ֔מָּה הֶ֣בֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh he·ḇel ma·‘ă·śêh ta‘·tu·‘îm bə·‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: They are worthless a work to be mocked In the time of their punishment they will perish

verses.original: חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב לֹֽא־ כְאֵ֜לֶּה כִּֽי־ ה֔וּא יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ וְשֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·leq ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ lō- ḵə·’êl·leh kî- hū yō·w·ṣêr hak·kōl wə·šê·ḇeṭ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: The Portion of Jacob is not like these for He is the Maker of all things and of the tribe of His inheritance the LORD of Hosts is His name

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔י מַפֵּץ־ כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְךָ֙ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י גּוֹיִ֔ם מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃ וְהִשְׁחַתִּ֥י בְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh lî map·pêṣ- kə·lê mil·ḥā·māh ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî gō·w·yim mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ wə·hiš·ḥat·tî ḇə·ḵā
verses.literal: You [are] My war club My weapon for battle With you I shatter nations with you I bring kingdoms to ruin

verses.original: בְךָ֔ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י ס֖וּס וְרֹֽכְב֑וֹ בְךָ֔ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י רֶ֖כֶב וְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî re·ḵeḇ wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw
verses.literal: With you I shatter the horse and rider with you I shatter the chariot and driver

verses.original: בְךָ֙ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֔ה בְךָ֖ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י זָקֵ֣ן וָנָ֑עַר בְךָ֔ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בָּח֖וּר וּבְתוּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî ’îš wə·’iš·šāh ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî zā·qên wā·nā·‘ar ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî bā·ḥūr ū·ḇə·ṯū·lāh
verses.literal: With you I shatter man and woman with you I shatter the old man and the youth with you I shatter the young man and the maiden

verses.original: בְךָ֙ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י רֹעֶ֣ה וְעֶדְר֔וֹ בְךָ֖ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י אִכָּ֣ר וְצִמְדּ֑וֹ בְךָ֔ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י פַּח֖וֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî rō·‘eh wə·‘eḏ·rōw ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî ’ik·kār wə·ṣim·dōw ḇə·ḵā wə·nip·paṣ·tî pa·ḥō·wṯ ū·sə·ḡā·nîm
verses.literal: With you I shatter the shepherd and his flock with you I shatter the farmer and his oxen with you I shatter the governors and officials

verses.original: לְעֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כָּל־ רָעָתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֥וּ בְצִיּ֖וֹן נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem wə·šil·lam·tî lə·ḇā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵōl yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḵaś·dîm ’êṯ kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea - for all the evil - they have done in Zion declares the LORD

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ הַ֤ר הַמַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׂרֵפָֽה׃ לְהַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā ham·maš·ḥîṯ har ham·maš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·ḡil·gal·tî·ḵā min- has·sə·lā·‘îm ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā śə·rê·p̄āh lə·har
verses.literal: Behold I am against you O destroying mountain you who devastate - the whole earth declares the LORD I will stretch out - My hand against you I will roll you over the cliffs and turn you into a charred mountain

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְפִנָּ֔ה לְמֽוֹסָד֑וֹת וְאֶ֖בֶן כִּֽי־ תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiq·ḥū mim·mə·ḵā ’e·ḇen lə·p̄in·nāh lə·mō·w·sā·ḏō·wṯ wə·’e·ḇen kî- tih·yeh šim·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone . . . or a foundation stone because you will become desolate forever declares the LORD

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ גּוֹיִ֔ם עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת עָלֶ֛יהָ אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ טִפְסָ֔ר עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַֽעֲלוּ־ ס֖וּס סָמָֽר׃ כְּיֶ֥לֶק
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- nês bā·’ā·reṣ tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār bag·gō·w·yim qad·də·šū gō·w·yim ‘ā·le·hā haš·mî·‘ū mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ ‘ā·le·hā ’ă·rā·raṭ min·nî wə·’aš·kə·nāz piq·ḏū ṭip̄·sār ‘ā·le·hā ha·‘ă·lū- sūs sā·mār kə·ye·leq
verses.literal: Raise a banner in the land Blow the ram’s horn among the nations Prepare the nations against her Summon the kingdoms against her Ararat Minni and Ashkenaz Appoint a captain against her bring up horses like swarming locusts

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת־ עָלֶ֤יהָ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת־ פַּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ סְגָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū ḡō·w·yim ’eṯ- ‘ā·le·hā mal·ḵê mā·ḏay ’eṯ- pa·ḥō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- kāl- sə·ḡā·ne·hā wə·’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: Prepare the nations - for battle against her the kings of the Medes - their governors - and all their officials - and all the lands they rule

verses.original: הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתִּרְעַ֥שׁ וַתָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ קָ֤מָה לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־ אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְשַׁמָּ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tir·‘aš wat·tā·ḥōl kî Yah·weh maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·ḇel qā·māh lā·śūm ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ bā·ḇel lə·šam·māh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD’s intentions against Babylon stand to make - the land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant

verses.original: גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל חָדְלוּ֩ לְהִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת גְבוּרָתָ֖ם נָשְׁתָ֥ה הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ הִצִּ֥יתוּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ḡib·bō·w·rê ḇā·ḇel ḥā·ḏə·lū lə·hil·lā·ḥêm yā·šə·ḇū bam·mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯām nā·šə·ṯāh hā·yū lə·nā·šîm miš·kə·nō·ṯe·hā hiṣ·ṣî·ṯū ḇə·rî·ḥe·hā niš·bə·rū
verses.literal: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting they sit in their strongholds Their strength is exhausted they have become like women Babylon’s homes have been set ablaze the bars of her gates are broken

verses.original: רָ֤ץ רָץ֙ לִקְרַאת־ יָר֔וּץ וּמַגִּ֖יד לִקְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְהַגִּיד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי־ עִיר֖וֹ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה מִקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rāṣ rāṣ liq·raṯ- yā·rūṣ ū·mag·gîḏ liq·raṯ mag·gîḏ lə·hag·gîḏ lə·me·leḵ bā·ḇel kî- ‘î·rōw nil·kə·ḏāh miq·qā·ṣeh
verses.literal: One courier races to meet another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end

verses.original: וְהַמַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְאֶת־ הָאֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·ma‘·bā·rō·wṯ niṯ·pā·śū wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḡam·mîm śā·rə·p̄ū ḇā·’êš wə·’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh niḇ·hā·lū
verses.literal: The fords have been seized - the marshes set on fire . . . and the soldiers . . . are terrified

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָמַ֜ר בַּת־ בָּבֶ֕ל כְּגֹ֖רֶן עֵ֣ת הִדְרִיכָ֑הּ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֔ט הַקָּצִ֖יר לָֽהּ׃ עֵֽת־ וּבָ֥אָה
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar baṯ- bā·ḇel kə·ḡō·ren ‘êṯ hiḏ·rî·ḵāh ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ haq·qā·ṣîr lāh ‘êṯ- ū·ḇā·’āh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled In just a little while . . . her harvest time will come

verses.original: נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶל֒ אֲכָלָנוּ הֲמָמָנוּ הִצִּיגָנוּ רִ֔יק כְּלִ֣י בְּלָעָנוּ כַּתַּנִּ֔ין מִלָּ֥א כְרֵשׂ֖וֹ מֵֽעֲדָנָ֑י הֱדִיחָנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel ʾă·ḵå̄·lå̄·nū hă·må̄·må̄·nū hiṣ·ṣī·ḡå̄·nū rîq kə·lî bə·lå̄·ʿå̄·nū kat·tan·nîn mil·lā ḵə·rê·śōw mê·‘ă·ḏā·nāy hɛ̆·ḏī·ḥå̄·nū
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me he has crushed me He has set me aside like an empty vessel he has swallowed me like a monster he filled his belly with my delicacies [and] vomited me out

verses.original: חֲמָסִ֤י וּשְׁאֵרִי֙ עַל־ בָּבֶ֔ל תֹּאמַ֖ר יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן וְדָמִי֙ אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים תֹּאמַ֖ר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mā·sî ū·šə·’ê·rî ‘al- bā·ḇel tō·mar yō·še·ḇeṯ ṣî·yō·wn wə·ḏā·mî ’el- yō·šə·ḇê ḵaś·dîm tō·mar yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon says the dweller of Zion May my blood be on the dwellers of Chaldea says Jerusalem

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנְנִי־ רָב֙ אֶת־ רִיבֵ֔ךְ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ נִקְמָתֵ֑ךְ וְהַחֲרַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יַמָּ֔הּ מְקוֹרָֽהּ׃ וְהֹבַשְׁתִּ֖י אֶת־
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî- rāḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇêḵ wə·niq·qam·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯêḵ wə·ha·ḥă·raḇ·tî ’eṯ- yam·māh mə·qō·w·rāh wə·hō·ḇaš·tî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Behold I will plead - your case and take vengeance - on your behalf I will dry up - her sea and make her springs run dry -

verses.original: בָבֶ֨ל׀ וְהָיְתָה֩ לְגַלִּ֧ים׀ מְעוֹן־ תַּנִּ֛ים שַׁמָּ֥ה וּשְׁרֵקָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·ḇel wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḡal·lîm mə·‘ō·wn- tan·nîm šam·māh ū·šə·rê·qāh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Babylon will become a heap of rubble a haunt for jackals an object of horror and scorn without inhabitant

verses.original: יִשְׁאָ֑גוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו כַּכְּפִרִ֣ים נָעֲר֖וּ אֲרָיֽוֹת׃ כְּגוֹרֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: yiš·’ā·ḡū yaḥ·dāw kak·kə·p̄i·rîm nā·‘ă·rū ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ kə·ḡō·w·rê
verses.literal: They will roar together like young lions they will growl like lion cubs

verses.original: בְּחֻמָּ֞ם אָשִׁ֣ית אֶת־ מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֗ם וְהִשְׁכַּרְתִּים֙ לְמַ֣עַן יַעֲלֹ֔זוּ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥum·mām ’ā·šîṯ ’eṯ- miš·tê·hem wə·hiš·kar·tîm lə·ma·‘an ya·‘ă·lō·zū wə·yā·šə·nū šə·naṯ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·lō yā·qî·ṣū nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: While they are flushed with heat I will serve them a feast and I will make them drunk so that they may revel then they will fall asleep . . . forever and never wake up declares the LORD

verses.original: אֽוֹרִידֵ֖ם כְּכָרִ֣ים לִטְב֑וֹחַ כְּאֵילִ֖ים עִם־ עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·rî·ḏêm kə·ḵā·rîm liṭ·ḇō·w·aḥ kə·’ê·lîm ‘im- ‘at·tū·ḏîm
verses.literal: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter like rams with male goats

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ שֵׁשַׁ֔ךְ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה תְּהִלַּ֣ת כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּתָּפֵ֖שׂ אֵ֣יךְ לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל הָיְתָ֧ה בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ šê·šaḵ nil·kə·ḏāh tə·hil·laṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tit·tā·p̄êś ’êḵ lə·šam·māh bā·ḇel hā·yə·ṯāh bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: How Sheshach has been captured The praise of all the earth has been seized What a horror Babylon has become among the nations

verses.original: הַיָּ֑ם עָלָ֥ה עַל־ בָּבֶ֖ל נִכְסָֽתָה׃ בַּהֲמ֥וֹן גַּלָּ֖יו
verses.transliteration: hay·yām ‘ā·lāh ‘al- bā·ḇel niḵ·sā·ṯāh ba·hă·mō·wn gal·lāw
verses.literal: The sea has come up over Babylon she is covered in turbulent waves

verses.original: עָרֶ֙יהָ֙ הָי֤וּ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה צִיָּ֣ה וַעֲרָבָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶץ אֶ֗רֶץ בָּהֵן֙ לֹֽא־ כָּל־ אִ֔ישׁ יֵשֵׁ֤ב וְלֹֽא־ בֶּן־ אָדָֽם׃ יַעֲבֹ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·re·hā hā·yū lə·šam·māh ṣî·yāh wa·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ’e·reṣ ’e·reṣ bā·hên lō- kāl- ’îš yê·šêḇ wə·lō- ben- ’ā·ḏām ya·‘ă·ḇōr bā·hên
verses.literal: Her cities have become a desolation a dry and arid land a land where no . . . one lives where no son of man passes through . . .

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עַל־ בֵּ֜ל בְּבָבֶ֗ל וְהֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶת־ מִפִּ֔יו בִּלְעוֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ ע֖וֹד יִנְהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו גַּם־ חוֹמַ֥ת בָּבֶ֖ל נָפָֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- bêl bə·ḇā·ḇel wə·hō·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- mip·pîw bil·‘ōw gō·w·yim wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ yin·hă·rū ’ê·lāw gam- ḥō·w·maṯ bā·ḇel nā·p̄ā·lāh
verses.literal: I will punish . . . Bel in Babylon I will make him spew out - - what he swallowed The nations will no longer stream to him even the wall of Babylon will fall

verses.original: צְא֤וּ מִתּוֹכָהּ֙ עַמִּ֔י וּמַלְּט֖וּ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ מֵחֲר֖וֹן אַף־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·’ū mit·tō·w·ḵāh ‘am·mî ū·mal·lə·ṭū nap̄·šōw ’îš ’eṯ- mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Come out of her My people Save your lives each of you - from the fierce anger of the LORD

verses.original: וּפֶן־ לְבַבְכֶם֙ יֵרַ֤ךְ וְתִֽירְא֔וּ בַּשְּׁמוּעָ֖ה הַנִּשְׁמַ֣עַת בָּאָ֑רֶץ הַשְּׁמוּעָ֗ה וּבָ֧א בַשָּׁנָ֣ה וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הַשְּׁמוּעָ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָה֙ וְחָמָ֣ס בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֹשֵׁ֖ל עַל־ מֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄en- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem yê·raḵ wə·ṯî·rə·’ū baš·šə·mū·‘āh han·niš·ma·‘aṯ bā·’ā·reṣ haš·šə·mū·‘āh ū·ḇā ḇaš·šā·nāh wə·’a·ḥă·rāw haš·šə·mū·‘āh baš·šā·nāh wə·ḥā·mās bā·’ā·reṣ ū·mō·šêl ‘al- mō·šêl
verses.literal: Do not let your heart grow faint and do not be afraid when the rumor is heard in the land for a rumor will come one year and then another the next year of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וּפָקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־ פְּסִילֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְכָל־ אַרְצָ֖הּ תֵּב֑וֹשׁ וְכָל־ חֲלָלֶ֖יהָ יִפְּל֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- pə·sî·lê ḇā·ḇel wə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣāh tê·ḇō·wōš wə·ḵāl ḥă·lā·le·hā yip·pə·lū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming when I will punish . . . the idols of Babylon Her entire land will suffer shame and all her slain will lie fallen within her

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֔רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם וְרִנְּנ֤וּ עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ כִּ֧י הַשּׁוֹדְדִ֖ים מִצָּפ֛וֹן יָבוֹא־ לָ֥הּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bā·hem wə·rin·nə·nū ‘al- bā·ḇel kî haš·šō·wḏ·ḏîm miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn yā·ḇō·w- lāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon because the destroyers from the north will come against her declares the LORD

verses.original: גַּם־ בָּבֶ֕ל לִנְפֹּ֖ל חַֽלְלֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־ חַֽלְלֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ נָפְל֖וּ לְבָבֶ֥ל
verses.transliteration: gam- bā·ḇel lin·pōl ḥal·lê yiś·rā·’êl gam- ḥal·lê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ nā·p̄ə·lū lə·ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: - Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel just as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon

verses.original: פְּלֵטִ֣ים מֵחֶ֔רֶב הִלְכ֖וּ אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ זִכְר֤וּ יְהוָ֔ה מֵֽרָחוֹק֙ אֶת־ וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·lê·ṭîm mê·ḥe·reḇ hil·ḵū ’al- ta·‘ă·mō·ḏū ziḵ·rū Yah·weh mê·rā·ḥō·wq ’eṯ- wî·rū·šā·lim ta·‘ă·leh ‘al- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: You who have escaped the sword depart and do not linger Remember the LORD from far away - and let Jerusalem come to mind

verses.original: בֹּ֚שְׁנוּ כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ חֶרְפָּ֔ה כְלִמָּ֖ה כִּסְּתָ֥ה פָּנֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֚י זָרִ֔ים בָּ֣אוּ עַֽל־ מִקְדְּשֵׁ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: bō·šə·nū kî- šā·ma‘·nū ḥer·pāh ḵə·lim·māh kis·sə·ṯāh pā·nê·nū kî zā·rîm bā·’ū ‘al- miq·də·šê Yah·weh bêṯ
verses.literal: We are ashamed because we have heard reproach disgrace has covered our faces because foreigners have entered . . . the holy places of the LORD’s house

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֖י עַל־ פְּסִילֶ֑יהָ וּבְכָל־ אַרְצָ֖הּ חָלָֽל׃ יֶאֱנֹ֥ק
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- pə·sî·le·hā ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣāh ḥā·lāl ye·’ĕ·nōq
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will punish . . . her idols and throughout her land the wounded will groan

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בָבֶל֙ תַעֲלֶ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְכִ֥י תְבַצֵּ֖ר מְר֣וֹם עֻזָּ֑הּ שֹׁדְדִ֛ים מֵאִתִּ֗י יָבֹ֧אוּ לָ֖הּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇā·ḇel ṯa·‘ă·leh haš·šā·ma·yim wə·ḵî ṯə·ḇaṣ·ṣêr mə·rō·wm ‘uz·zāh šō·ḏə·ḏîm mê·’it·tî yā·ḇō·’ū lāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens . . . and fortifies her lofty stronghold the destroyers I send will come against her declares the LORD

verses.original: ק֥וֹל זְעָקָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל גָּד֖וֹל וְשֶׁ֥בֶר מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl zə·‘ā·qāh mib·bā·ḇel gā·ḏō·wl wə·še·ḇer mê·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm
verses.literal: The sound of a cry [comes from] Babylon the sound of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד בָּבֶ֔ל וְאִבַּ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה גָּד֑וֹל ק֣וֹל גַלֵּיהֶם֙ וְהָמ֤וּ רַבִּ֔ים כְּמַ֣יִם שְׁא֖וֹן קוֹלָֽם׃ נִתַּ֥ן
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ’eṯ- šō·ḏêḏ bā·ḇel wə·’ib·baḏ mim·men·nāh gā·ḏō·wl qō·wl ḡal·lê·hem wə·hā·mū rab·bîm kə·ma·yim šə·’ō·wn qō·w·lām nit·tan
verses.literal: For the LORD - will destroy Babylon He will silence . . . her mighty voice The waves will roar like great waters the tumult of their voices will resound

verses.original: כִּי֩ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד בָ֨א עָלֶ֤יהָ עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ גִּבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ וְנִלְכְּדוּ֙ קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֑ם חִתְּתָ֖ה כִּ֣י יְהוָ֖ה אֵ֧ל גְּמֻל֛וֹת שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî šō·w·ḏêḏ ḇā ‘ā·le·hā ‘al- bā·ḇel gib·bō·w·re·hā wə·nil·kə·ḏū qaš·šə·ṯō·w·ṯām ḥit·tə·ṯāh kî Yah·weh ’êl gə·mu·lō·wṯ šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: For a destroyer is coming against her against Babylon Her warriors will be captured [and] their bows will be broken for the LORD is a God of retribution He will repay in full . . .

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֨יהָ וַחֲכָמֶ֜יהָ וְ֠הִשְׁכַּרְתִּי פַּחוֹתֶ֤יהָ וּסְגָנֶ֙יהָ֙ וְגִבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֨ם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: śā·re·hā wa·ḥă·ḵā·me·hā wə·hiš·kar·tî pa·ḥō·w·ṯe·hā ū·sə·ḡā·ne·hā wə·ḡib·bō·w·re·hā wə·yā·šə·nū šə·naṯ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·lō yā·qî·ṣū nə·’um- ham·me·leḵ šə·mōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will make her princes and wise men drunk along with her governors officials and warriors Then they will fall asleep . . . forever and not wake up declares the King whose name is the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אָמַ֞ר בָּבֶ֤ל הָֽרְחָבָה֙ חֹ֠מוֹת עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר הַגְּבֹהִ֖ים וּשְׁעָרֶ֥יהָ יִצַּ֑תּוּ בָּאֵ֣שׁ וְיִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּדֵי־ רִ֛יק וּלְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּדֵי־ וְיָעֵֽפוּ׃ס אֵ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar bā·ḇel hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh ḥō·mō·wṯ ‘ar·‘êr tiṯ·‘ar·‘ār hag·gə·ḇō·hîm ū·šə·‘ā·re·hā yiṣ·ṣat·tū bā·’êš wə·yiḡ·‘ū ‘am·mîm bə·ḏê- rîq ū·lə·’um·mîm bə·ḏê- wə·yā·‘ê·p̄ū ’êš
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Babylon’s thick walls will be leveled . . . and her high gates consumed by fire So the labor of the people vvv will be for nothing the nations . . . will exhaust themselves to fuel the flames

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא אֶת־ צִוָּ֣ה׀ וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה שַׂ֥ר מְנוּחָֽה׃ שְׂרָיָ֣ה בֶן־ נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־ מַחְסֵיָה֒ בְּלֶכְתּ֞וֹ בָּבֶ֔ל אֶת־ מֶֽלֶךְ־ צִדְקִיָּ֤הוּ יְהוּדָה֙ הָרְבִעִ֖ית בִּשְׁנַ֥ת לְמָלְכ֑וֹ
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh ū·śə·rā·yāh śar mə·nū·ḥāh śə·rā·yāh ḇen- nê·rî·yāh ben- maḥ·sê·yāh bə·leḵ·tōw bā·ḇel ’eṯ- me·leḵ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū yə·hū·ḏāh hā·rə·ḇi·‘îṯ biš·naṯ lə·mā·lə·ḵōw
verses.literal: [This is] the message that Jeremiah the prophet - gave - vvv to the quartermaster Seraiah son of Neriah the son of Mahseiah when he went to Babylon with King Zedekiah of Judah in the fourth year of Zedekiah’s reign

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֧ת וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֶל־ אֶחָ֑ד אֵ֚ת סֵ֣פֶר כָּל־ הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ בָּבֶ֖ל כָּל־ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים אֶל־ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū ’êṯ way·yiḵ·tōḇ ’el- ’e·ḥāḏ ’êṯ sê·p̄er kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- tā·ḇō·w ’el- bā·ḇel kāl- hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm hak·kə·ṯu·ḇîm ’el- bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Jeremiah - had written on a single - scroll about all the disaster that would come upon Babylon all these words that had been written concerning Babylon

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ שְׂרָיָ֑ה כְּבֹאֲךָ֣ בָבֶ֔ל וְֽרָאִ֔יתָ כָּל־ הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים וְֽקָרָ֔אתָ אֵ֥ת
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’el- śə·rā·yāh kə·ḇō·’ă·ḵā ḇā·ḇel wə·rā·’î·ṯā kāl- hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm wə·qā·rā·ṯā ’êṯ
verses.literal: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah When you get to Babylon see that you read all these words aloud -

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ יְהוָה֙ אַתָּ֨ה דִבַּ֜רְתָּ אֶל־ לְהַכְרִית֔וֹ הַזֶּה֙ הַמָּק֤וֹם לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֱיֽוֹת־ בּוֹ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב לְמֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה כִּֽי־ תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃ שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā Yah·weh ’at·tāh ḏib·bar·tā ’el- lə·haḵ·rî·ṯōw haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm lə·ḇil·tî hĕ·yō·wṯ- bōw yō·wō·šêḇ lə·mê·’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh kî- tih·yeh šim·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and say O LORD You have promised . . . to cut off this place so that no one will remain neither man nor beast Indeed it will be desolate forever

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּכַלֹּ֣תְךָ֔ לִקְרֹ֖א אֶת־ הַזֶּ֑ה הַסֵּ֣פֶר תִּקְשֹׁ֤ר אֶ֔בֶן עָלָיו֙ וְהִשְׁלַכְתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ תּ֥וֹךְ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ḵal·lō·ṯə·ḵā liq·rō ’eṯ- haz·zeh has·sê·p̄er tiq·šōr ’e·ḇen ‘ā·lāw wə·hiš·laḵ·tōw ’el- tō·wḵ pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: - When you finish reading - this scroll tie a stone to it and cast it into . . . the Euphrates

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כָּ֠כָה בָּבֶ֤ל תִּשְׁקַ֨ע וְלֹֽא־ תָקוּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ וְיָעֵ֑פוּ הֵ֖נָּה עַד־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kā·ḵāh bā·ḇel tiš·qa‘ wə·lō- ṯā·qūm mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî ‘ā·le·hā wə·yā·‘ê·p̄ū hên·nāh ‘aḏ- diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū
verses.literal: Then you are to say In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again because of the disaster - I will bring upon her And [her people] will grow weary Here end the words of Jeremiah
